title: Tmux execute_command references unsurfaced result polling tool
wanted_capability: When tmux MCP execute_command is exposed to an interactive agent, the paired command-result polling primitive should also be surfaced or the tool guidance should name an available validation path.
fallback_used: Captured the pane and inspected the TMUX_MCP_DONE marker instead of polling the command id.
evidence: session: tmux MCP smoke used execute_command then capture_pane because get-command-result was not exposed
resolution_note: Premise no longer holds: the tmux MCP surface co-exposes the paired result-polling primitive (get-command-result) alongside execute-command — both are available to an interactive agent in the same deferred-tool set (verified live this session, 2026-06-08, while smoke-testing the Fleet TUI via tmux). The orphaned-execute_command concern does not manifest. Residual scope (whether an external MCP server's own tool guidance names the validation path) is outside blackbox's surface to fix. Closing as acknowledged rather than addressed since no blackbox code change was required.
